description: 后对马 — 后王协作，驱逐马王后吃马获胜

intro.popup_en: The knight will keep checking to disrupt White, but the queen and king can coordinate to expose and capture it.
intro.popup: ♛♞ <b>马会不断将军干扰，但后王配合可以逼马暴露被吃！

outro.popup_en: White is winning. Bring the queen and king closer, seize the chance to capture the knight, and convert the advantage.
outro.popup: ✅ <b>白方将获胜！要点：白后和白王逼近，寻机吃掉马，最终将取得胜利。

moves.popup_en: The white king leaves the corner and heads toward the center.
moves.popup: ♔ 白王从角落出发，向中心靠拢。

moves.popup_en: The black king advances actively toward the center to support the knight.
moves.popup: 黑王主动进中心，试图配合马。

moves.popup_en: The knight checks. Knights are good at using checks to disrupt White's rhythm.
moves.popup: 马将军！马擅长用将军来消耗白方节奏。

moves.popup_en: The white king steps out of check and keeps approaching.
moves.popup: 白王躲开将军，继续靠近。

moves.popup_en: The knight checks again, trying to divert the white king.
moves.popup: 马再次将军，试图让白王偏离方向。

moves.popup_en: The white king stays calm, avoids the check, and continues toward the target.
moves.popup: 白王不慌不忙，绕开将军继续进攻方向。

moves.popup_en: The knight retreats to defend for the moment.
The queen checks and drives the black king away, separating it from the knight.
moves.popup: ♛ 白后将军，驱赶黑王，让马和王分离！

moves.popup_en: The black king is forced to move.
The white king continues to advance.
The knight checks again as the king draws near.
The black king retreats, and the position becomes increasingly difficult.
moves.popup: 黑王撤退，局势越来越难。

moves.popup_en: The queen takes up a strong position and watches for a chance to capture the knight.
moves.popup: ♛ 白后将军， 伺机吃马。

moves.popup_en: The knight escapes to c6 and looks for a new outpost.
The white king advances, preparing to capture the knight.
The knight checks and forces the white king away.
